LiDio spielt die Musik, die dir gehört –:
LiDio plays the music that belongs to you – from your Emby, Jellyfin or Navidrome at home
or from folders on the device. Used like the Music app on iPhone and Mac. No subscription.
Gebaut wie die Musik-App.<br><span style:
Built like the Music app.
For your own collection.
Jahrelang Platten, CDs und Dateien gesam: Years spent collecting records, CDs and files – and then you are supposed to listen to them only in a subscription app? LiDio brings your collection to phone and computer the way you know it from Apple: large covers, clear lists, “Now Playing” with lyrics. Designed following Apple’s Human Interface Guidelines, in the modern glass look or classic.
Start mit Mixen für dich, Alben, Interpr: Home with mixes for you, albums, artists, songs, genres, favourite songs and playlists – fast, even with tens of thousands of songs.
Das Cover füllt den Raum, seine Farben l: The cover fills the space, its colours lie softly behind it, the lyrics scroll along – and a click on a line jumps there. Lyrics come from your server or, if you like, from lrclib.net.
Playlists aus anderen Apps, von Deezer o: Simply bring along playlists from other apps, from Deezer or Spotify: LiDio matches every song with your server – even if it is called “(Remastered 2011)” there.
Gefunden, unsicher, fehlt:</b> grün, ora: Found, unsure, missing: green, orange, red – for unsure ones you choose yourself.
Was fehlt, bleibt sichtbar:</b> grau an: What is missing stays visible: grey in its place and in the playlist’s description – readable in any app.
Dateien:</b> M3U, M3U8, PLS, XSPF, CSV o: Files: M3U, M3U8, PLS, XSPF, CSV or plain text.
Freigeben:</b> für alle auf deinem Serve: Share: with everyone on your server or individual people – to listen or to edit together.
Ein Schalter, und LiDio wird zum Winamp-: One switch and LiDio becomes a Winamp 2 player – with real skins from the Winamp Skin Museum, equalizer, spectrum and playlist window. And Milkdrop paints what you hear.
Zehntausende Skins</b> zum Durchsuchen,: Tens of thousands of skins to browse, one click to put one on.
Equalizer</b> mit zehn Bändern, der wirk: Equalizer with ten bands that really affects the sound.
Milkdrop</b> über projectM – im Fenster: Milkdrop via projectM – in a window or full screen.
Mini-Player</b> im Apple-Stil, wenn es s: Mini player in Apple style, when you want it simple.
Dazu Ordner auf dem Gerät. Zu Hause die: Plus folders on the device. The fast address at home, the second one on the go – LiDio chooses by itself.
Titel, Alben und Playlists aufs Gerät la: Download songs, albums and playlists to the device – one after another, with a progress ring on every song.
Ein Link in Signal & Co. – wer LiDio hat: A link in Signal & co. – anyone who has LiDio taps it and hears the song from their own library.
Der Stern landet auf deinem Server. Dara: The star lands on your server. From it come the Favourites Mix and “Discover” with things you have not heard yet.
Als Nächstes, Zuletzt, umsortieren – und: Up Next, History, reorder – and when the list ends, it carries on with similar music from your collection.
Beim ersten Start zeigt ein kurzer Rundg: On first launch a short tour shows the most important places; the guide is in the app.
LiDio spricht mit deinem Server – und so: LiDio talks to your server – and otherwise only where you switch it on yourself. No account with us, nothing in a cloud.
Liedtexte (lrclib.net), Deezer-Playlists: LiDio asks for lyrics (lrclib.net), Deezer playlists and the skin museum only when you use them – and only sends what is needed: title and artist, the search term.
